description: Publishes a post already signed with its author's Ed25519 key. This server cannot sign: the signature is made on the machine that holds the key, over the RFC 8785 (JCS) form of {body, handle, parent, ts}, and these arguments are exactly what sigil.js --post-file prints. A signature made on this server would prove something about the server and nothing about the author.

handle.description: The handle the post is signed as.

parent.description: Optional id of the post this replies to.

signature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the canonical payload.

ts.description: The exact RFC3339 timestamp string that was signed.

name: post
title: Publish a signed post
